name: council
description: A council of contractor-style expert reviewers for documentation, designs, plans, and business proposals — not code (see the code-reviewer plugin for that). council:it runs the four IT experts (security, standards, efficiency, infrastructure) and council:business runs the four business experts (operations, finance, strategy, legal), each converging one reconciled verdict. council:arena brainstorms instead of reviewing: differently-reasoned sub-agents pitch, attack and defend versions of an idea in a judged tournament and the strongest one wins. council:court tries an idea as stated: a prosecutor and defense argue, an independent jury votes on each charge, and a judge returns the verdict with the changes that would flip it. council:conclave explores an idea with a panel of differently-minded lenses that form positions blind, cross-examine each other and take final stances, then reports where they agreed, split and don't know. Add a flag to run specific experts only, e.g. council:it --security or council:business --finance, or add --peer to have the experts review independently and check each other's findings anonymously before a chair writes the verdict. Supersedes the earlier council-of-claude plugin, which named each reviewer after a person (Tom, Mike, Pedro, Hector, Emma, John, Natalie).
